description: Read the project's Postgres. action `query`: run read-only SQL (5 s timeout, max 500 rows). action `tables`: list tables with row counts and sizes. action `snapshots`: snapshots taken before migrations. Temporary credentials come from db_connection; dumps from db_export; restores from db_restore.
